meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 装上后，编辑类操作（apply_patch、write、edit 等）成功后会触发钩子；若 comment-checker 报出警告，Codex 会收到阻塞性反馈，须先修正或解释被标记的注释再继续。
howto.when: 每次 apply_patch、write、edit 等编辑类工具成功调用后触发；非编辑类工具不触发，检查器程序缺失时无输出。

say.text: 这条注释警告是什么意思？
say.note: Codex 会解释被标记的注释

say.text: 改掉被标记的注释，然后继续。
say.note: Codex 修正注释后再往下走

say.text: 说明为什么这条注释被标记，我不改。

howto.what_en: After install, successful edit-like calls (apply_patch, write, edit, etc.) fire a hook; if comment-checker warns, Codex gets blocking feedback and must fix or explain the flagged comment before continuing.
howto.when_en: Fires after each successful apply_patch, write, edit, or similar edit-like call; non-edit tools are ignored, and a missing checker binary produces no output.

say_en.text: What does this comment warning mean?
Fix the flagged comment, then continue.
say_en.note: Codex edits the comment and moves on

say_en.text: Explain why this comment was flagged; I won't change it.
